changelog: Updates are manual only: no more nightly timer, the web app shows when a new version is available and the parent installs it. New animated owl TV screens: ready, rest, listening, unknown figurine (stays while the figurine is on), setup while pairing a figurine, and a new boot screen with a progress bar. While an update runs the TV shows the owl with gears, a bar that follows the update steps and a note not to switch Cucù off; nothing starts meanwhile. Time limits reload as soon as they are saved. Thinner progress bar.
